title: Dance Fever Studios
specs: Top rated Argentine tango dance studio with friendly and professional instructors
No partner needed; most students come solo
Recommended lightweight, comfortable leather-soled shoes; avoid boots and sticky rubber soles
Group classes can have 8 to 40 students; classes with fewer than 8 students may be canceled
includes: Private room for private tango lessons
blurb: Guests can take private lessons or join group classes to learn partner dances such as salsa, Argentine tango, ballroom, and Latin dances. Private lessons are one-on-one with professional dancers and allow learning at a personal pace. Group classes are sequential, usually lasting 6-8 weeks or two months, and do not require a partner.
extraNote: Private lessons paid in advance; cancellations with less than 24 hours (or 12 hours for tango) notice forfeit without refund or credit · Group classes require pre-registration; no same day registration · No refunds once group cycle has begun · $25 charge for credit card cancellation, bounced check, or class cancellation for group classes; $15 charge for credit card cancellation or bounced check for tango classes · 20th Street dance studio in Brooklyn, 10 minutes over the Verrazano Bridge from Staten Island
